content_sections.heading: ACTREC Junior Research Fellow Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the ACTREC Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download ACTREC Junior Research Fellow Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: M.Sc. degree in Life Sciences, Microbiology, Biotechnology, and other biology related subjects from recognized university with National Level Exams qualified conducted by Central Government Agencies and Institutions i.e. DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MHRD, ICMR, IISc, ICAR, IISER etc. 1-2 years experience in cancer biology, cell culture, molecular biology, and animal handling preferred.

content_sections.heading: ACTREC Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Junior Research Fellow at Advanced Centre for Treatment, Research and Education in Cancer (ACTREC).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy for the Junior Research Fellow position.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview directly.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for application is the Walk-in Interview date, which is 21 September 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must have an M.Sc. degree in Life Sciences, Microbiology, Biotechnology, or other biology-related subjects with qualified National Level Exams.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for this post is 32 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for this position?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 46,990/- per month (Rs. 37,000 + 27% HRA).

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST).

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Advanced Centre for Treatment, Research and Education in Cancer (ACTREC), Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, 410210.
